source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of esters (PDF 114).

blocks.text: Ester dheere dheere carboxylic acid aur alcohol (ya phenol) mein hydrolyse hota hai; reaction tezaab ya base se catalyse hota hai. Aliphatic esters topic 23.4.1 mein bayan hue. Aromatic esters bhi isi tarah hydrolyse ho kar aryl carboxylic acids aur alcohols ya phenol dete hain: C6H5COOC2H5 + H2O -> C6H5COOH + C2H5OH (ethyl benzoate se benzoic acid aur ethanol, H+ ya OH-); C6H5COOCH3 + H2O -> C6H5COOH + CH3OH (methyl benzoate se benzoic acid aur methanol).

blocks.alt: Oopar: R-CO-OH + H-O-R' <=> R-CO-O-R' + H2O, tezaab ka OH aur alcohol ka H narangi dabbon mein, aur ethyl propanoate ki misal. Beech: CH3COCl + CH3CH2OH -> CH3COOCH2CH3 + HCl aur C6H5COCl + C6H5OH -> C6H5COOC6H5 + HCl, jo mukammal hote hain. Neeche: ethyl benzoate aur methyl benzoate ki hydrolysis se benzoic acid aur alcohol.
blocks.caption: Esters banana aur hydrolyse karna (kitab ke mua'adlon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Esterification mein banne wala paani tezaab ke OH aur alcohol ke H se aata hai. Tezaab ki jagah acyl chloride use karne se tez aur mukammal reaction hota hai kyunke paani ki jagah HCl nikalta hai. Hydrolysis esterification ka ulat hai, ester ko wapas tezaab aur alcohol mein torta hai.

blocks.prompt: Methyl benzoate ko halke tezaab se hydrolyse karne ke products kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Benzoic acid, C6H5COOH, aur methanol, CH3OH.

items: Ester + paani -> tezaab + alcohol (tezaab ya base catalyst); base ke saath tezaab namak ki shakal mein.
